headline: Public hearings on parking, fence, and zoning requests at Suffolk, Beech, Dwight, and Pine streets.
summary: All five public hearing items are continued from earlier meetings, including the Suffolk Street parking request. Two land division plans, for Charles Hill Road and Sun Valley Road, are also on the agenda.
items: Special permit to reduce parking requirements at 61-69 Suffolk St (SP 2026-14), continued
Special permit to exceed fence height at 230-232 Beech Street (SP 2026-7), continued
Special permit to reduce parking requirements at 956 Dwight St (SP 2026-15), continued
Zone change at 120 & 0 Pine Street from BL to BH (ZC 2026-9), continued
Zone change for Native Plants (ZC 2026-4), continued
Approval-not-required (ANR) plan for Charles Hill Road (168-00-029)
Approval-not-required (ANR) plan for Sun Valley Road (181-00-0136/181-00-137)
